docker-compose.description: Exclude the example compose file from Renovate. Scoped under the docker-compose manager rather than set at top level: a top-level ignorePaths REPLACES the list inherited from :ignoreModulesAndTests (node_modules, vendor, tests, etc.) instead of merging with it
